languageHelp: Language of the app. The AI assistant also answers, speaks and listens in it.
modelHelp: The OpenAI model that writes the SQL, explains the results, picks the charts and names the conversations. Only the text models the key can use are listed.
voiceHelp: Spoken answers of the AI assistant. ElevenLabs sounds more natural; OpenAI is used when it is off or not configured.
elevenLabsMissing: Add elevenlabs_api_key to server/secrets.yml to enable it.
savedOnServer: Your preferences (language, model and voice) are saved on the server and follow you to any browser.
saveError: Your preferences could not be saved on the server.
savedInBrowser: With DuckDB in the browser there is no server: the language, your OpenAI key and the model are kept only in this browser.
integrationsHelp: What the server read from config.yml and secrets.yml. Values are never shown.
statusError: Could not read the server settings.
